issue.title: E2: Exact-candidate release train and steward
issue.description: Every sase release is a sealed candidate built once at its tag: the wheel and sdist plus an exact `sase-core-rs==X.Y.Z` with its full file set and digests. It is qualified against the published core, exercised on Linux and macOS, published from the retained bytes with digest-checked resume, and confirmed from PyPI before it is un-drafted. One stateless steward decides release merges and the core cut, and every blocked release names a typed reason and its owner.

payload.entry: PUBLISH INTEGRATION SEAM from release-wiring (sase-1n6.5.1.4): publication (sase-1n6.6) must depend on the qualify job verdict plus exercise, never on the qualify-ci aggregate. qualify exposes verdict/observation/token/run-id/attempt/candidate-id/generation/intended-core-version/tested-core-version outputs; its result is success-with-red-verdict only via the always() final verdict step, so publish needs an explicit status condition such as needs.qualify.outputs.verdict == pass. That condition must pass through required verdicts even when an advisory ancestor failed: default success propagation would silently skip publication after a red advisory job fails qualify-ci. Red qualification observations persist on the draft (release) or as artifacts (rehearse) under candidate-gen<N>-qualification-run<R>-attempt<A>.json.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: tools/release_candidate parse_expected_suffixes (release_candidate:557-568, added by sase-1n6.2 exact-build in 110214f51c) only matches the bracketed list form `EXPECTED_DIST_SUFFIXES: [...]`, but sase-core's real release-plz.yml uses the YAML block form `EXPECTED_DIST_SUFFIXES: |` (line 80 at v0.42.1 and master). Repro on sase master e10fa95c0d: `git -C <sase-core> show v0.42.1:.github/workflows/release-plz.yml > rp.yml; python3 tools/release_candidate core-suffixes --file rp.yml --out o.json` -> `REFUSED EXPECTED_DIST_SUFFIXES not found in release-plz.yml`, exit 2. Impact: release.yml's 'core-suffixes' step (release.yml:206-211) feeds --expected-core-suffixes to seal, so a real tagged release run would refuse before sealing the candidate manifest. tools/_release_core.py:51,125 already parses the block form (core-ensure); release_candidate should reuse that single parser instead of its own regex, and its tests should use a real-shaped release-plz.yml fixture. Found by the sase-1n6.7.1 land agent while checking evaluator integration drift; not caused by sase-1n6.7.1 (the steward reads suffixes only through _release_core).

Only the literal `true` enables merges; missing or any other value means disabled (tools/_release_watch.py MERGE_AUTHORITY_ENV, passed through .github/workflows/release-steward.yml). After confirming no queued/running release.yml run, dispatched green rehearse 39495874381 (https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/39495874381), 0.41.0 probe rehearse 39495879106 (https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/39495879106), and Full CI 39495882967 (https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/39495882967). All are workflow_dispatch at the same headSha 4adee846d3c32f0927639193f3d3c2717df946ee. The probe preflight against current source still fails only for missing mobile_pairing_issue (1 of 866). Independent source-containment check: sase-core-revision.txt is 6f354df4d9650777087c06cc937526d95671d493; it is on sase-core origin/master but `git tag --contains` finds no published tag (latest tag v0.42.1). This updates existing DISCOVERED ISSUE #1; the successful qualification of the 0.42.0 wheel cannot prove containment of the pinned source. Await workflow results, retain/re-evaluate artifacts, then keep this phase open and monitor the next daily cut if that gap still prevents trustworthy acceptance.

At dispatch time the sase-core v0.42.2 release PR #333 remained OPEN (https://github.com/sase-org/sase-core/pull/333; head eae5bae4ddd057f82f1a0c53c459b2b27cbab2b9), so a next daily cut is pending. After collecting and retaining the three current run results, monitor the bounded next cut if 6f354df4d9650777087c06cc937526d95671d493 is still absent from all published tags; do not close this phase while that gap prevents trustworthy acceptance.

LIVE-PROOF RESULT — compared SHA 4adee846d3c32f0927639193f3d3c2717df946ee. Run metadata, logs, artifact-download results, and acceptance mapping are retained at file:explicit:79476a9749f868b5d7c7f2d4 and file:explicit:f27fe0e4e8e21041282b6bfd; green-run API metadata is also retained at file:explicit:50fd3359e020644fc0d1bc88.

Both rehearsals failed in identity with SyntaxError: '(' was never closed in the inline Python version reader. Candidate-build was never produced; downstream exercise/qualification downloads reported artifact not found and observation upload had no path. No candidate manifest, green/probe observation, or evaluator input/output exists; neither acceptance result can be re-evaluated. No rerun was eligible or attempted.

REPROOF REQUIRED: repaired the missing closing parenthesis in .github/workflows/release.yml and added a contract assertion compiling the embedded Python command in tests/test_github_actions_release.py. Focused release workflow suite: 26 passed; just fmt completed. The fix needs to land, then green/probe rehearsal and source comparison must be dispatched and retained at one SHA. sase tool run check is being handed to a verify monitor.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Full CI run 39495882967 failed before lint/tests because build-core setup-uv's cache glob sase-core/**/pyproject.toml matched no files before the core checkout. Lint and test (3.12)/(3.13)/(3.14) were skipped; source proof is unmet. No rerun because the blocking failure was setup, not test-only.

Containment remains a separate blocker. Compared SHA used pin 6f354df4d9650777087c06cc937526d95671d493. Current origin/master eb96eafd442a28cd96ad2e4c35603845d179450c carries pin ce6104b19cf36a8c71267c67c1afa0b52ac4c8ec; that pin is current sase-core master and no published tag contains it.
